# SCI-NOI v0.1 — Decision Log

Status: Stage A launch decisions applied; packet awaiting owner approval

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Launch date: `2026-08-29`

## Owner-Approved Launch Decisions

| Decision | Applied substance |
| --- | --- |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D001` | Launch SCI-NOI v0.1 as a recovery-first Stage A effort at high reasoning effort after completion of SCI-JINC. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D002` | Use one SCI-NOI package with Family G realization generation and Family U empirical uncertainty inference, separated by a hard typed boundary. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D003` | Add Family Z standardized signal as a separate method/product identity within SCI-NOI, not a separate package and not an uncertainty estimate. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D004` | Limit an unvalidated Family Z claim to “standardized by the stated empirical scale,” not Gaussian significance or detection probability. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D005` | Treat fixed-state and relearned generation as distinct possible methods that answer different questions; do not mix them or select a baseline in Stage A. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D006` | Keep validity, MAP/PTC coefficients, assignments, realization QC, variance/covariance, empirical weights, and standardized signal separately typed. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D007` | Prohibit automatic use of an empirical NOI weight as a MAP-facing PTC coefficient. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D008` | Preserve MAP and JINC parents unchanged; attach NOI results as exact versioned companions. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D009` | Permit honest diagonal, stationary/kernel, structured, ensemble, projected, full, or unavailable covariance states; do not mandate dense covariance. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D010` | Make realization persistence plan-controlled; permit exact regeneration or streaming sufficient statistics with explicit audit limitations. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D011` | Recover prior science, implementation, ambiguities, dependencies, and evidence classification before new drafting. |
| `SCI-NOI-PROCESS-D012` | Stop after Stage A owner review and the first owner question; do not begin Stage B, implementation, or frozen MAP/JINC/PTC modification. |

## Recovery Dispositions

| Decision | Stage A treatment |
| --- | --- |
| `SCI-NOI-RECOVERY-D001` | Reuse both recovered implementation-independent cores once, under one binding supersession cover. |
| `SCI-NOI-RECOVERY-D002` | Preserve the NOI-001 fixed-state mathematics as one method family, not as the selected ordinary method. |
| `SCI-NOI-RECOVERY-D003` | Preserve NOI-002 finite-design and covariance mathematics without inheriting its old package split or source-imprinted-only premise. |
| `SCI-NOI-RECOVERY-D004` | Abstract stable historical owner policies into sanitized author controls; exclude raw audit/repair/integration records. |
| `SCI-NOI-RECOVERY-D005` | Treat the internal noise plan as mixed reusable reasoning and recommendations; abstract estimator-dependent uncertainty and streaming ideas, supersede coefficient/significance conflicts, and exclude the source. |
| `SCI-NOI-RECOVERY-D006` | Quarantine current source and validation as implementation evidence. Historical candidate acceptance is not carried to the current contract-library ancestry. |
| `SCI-NOI-RECOVERY-D007` | Defer deterministic/Wiener filter mathematics, mode-specific interpretation, and FRUIT recurrence to their owning packages while making their NOI interfaces explicit. |

## Pending Owner Gate

Owner approval must cover or revise:

- the exact Scope Brief;
- the recovered-core supersession cover;
- the conventions/ownership extract;
- the proposed operator/product taxonomy;
- the open-question routing; and
- every exact content hash in the author manifest.

Approval of Stage A would authorize only a later fresh implementation-blind
Stage B author. It would not approve future scientific content or any
implementation/evidence claim.
